correctness.rationale: The two local rings have 25 elements and invertibility criterion det mod5 !=0. Every 2x2 coefficient array over each ring (25^4 possibilities) is checked for square I; 752 involutions result, including ±I. A separately authored C++ exact arithmetic census enumerated every one of 752^2 ordered pairs, computed product order by repeated multiplication through 300, and verified the 12/10 order bins, common commuting-pair count 4504 and column sums 565504. Orders 25,50 occur in Z25 with 150000 pairs each and none in the dual numbers ring. This is a complete finite fact, not an unbounded theorem.

originality.rationale: Singla 2010 Theorem 1.2 proves residue-field invariance of representation-degree distribution, not involution pair product-order distribution. The two length-two local rings have same residue field, size and matched involution/commutation counts; exact product order histogram separates ramification at 25 and 50. A natural finite group invariant not recoverable from degree distribution was independently exhausted.
